provider: Google Cloud Developer Device Platform (Device Run, Preview)
summary: Cloud device testing is implemented as an opt-in workflow. It has not run because Google Cloud access is not configured. Missing data is not a pass.

default.why: Oldest Android version in the current DDP catalog; API 23 is not offered.

retention.note: GitHub Actions artifacts expire after 30 days; the Cloud Storage bucket should carry an equivalent lifecycle rule.

privacy.note: Only CI-built APKs and generated test fixtures are uploaded. No user file, account, advertising id, or device identifier is collected.
